package offers

import (
 "reflect"
 "testing"
)

func TestPageOffsetOverflow(t *testing.T) {
 defer func() {
  recovered := recover()
  if recovered != nil {
   t.Errorf("valid page request panicked: %v", recovered)
  }
 }()
 offers := List{{SKU: "a", Price: 100}, {SKU: "b", Price: 200}}
 largestSize := PageSize(int(^uint(0) >> 1))
 got := PageOffers(offers, 1, largestSize)
 if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, offers[1:]) {
  t.Fatalf("got %v, want remaining offer %v", got, offers[1:])
 }
}
